# HITL Per-Stream RACI Assignment (docx/pdf) — Locked Design Spec

**Status:** Approved by Tim King, August 9, 2026, first pass — no correction rounds needed. This is the canonical spec for `hitl_raci_stream_<slug>_final.docx`. Generated by the stream-parameter-driven script `gen_stream_raci.js`, invoked as:

```
node gen_stream_raci.js <path-to-domain-json> "<Stream Name>" <output-slug>
# e.g. node gen_stream_raci.js pcf7_full.json "Recruit-to-Hire" recruit_to_hire_pcf7
#      node gen_stream_raci.js pcf7_full.json "Enable & Govern" enable_and_govern_pcf7
```

This doc type replaces the older `hitl_role_assignment_raci_<stream>_final.docx` ("Standalone RACI doc," see the now-superseded entry in `HITL_Docx_Formatting_Specs` history). It shares its visual language and structural skeleton with the domain-wide `hitl_raci_<slug>_final.docx` (see `HITL_RACI_Docx_Spec.md`) — same Pattern column, same R/A/C/I treatment, same locked fonts/borders/header style — scoped down to one value stream's L3/L4 rows instead of a full domain, and ported to portrait like its sibling `hitl_valuestream_<slug>_final.docx` (see `HITL_ValueStreamProfile_Docx_Spec.md`).

---

## 1. Page setup

Identical to the Value Stream Profile spec: portrait, 12240×15840, margins 1000/1100/1000/1100, header/footer 708, content width 10040 DXA, Segoe UI default font.

## 2. Repeating page header / footer

Header line 1: "The Human-AI Partnership Framework" (bold, `1B4F8A`, size 13). Header line 2: "`{d.pcf}` — `{Stream Name}` — RACI Assignment" (italic, `888888`, size 13 — `d.pcf` already contains "PCF", never prepend it again). Footer: centered "Page X of Y", same as every other locked doc type.

## 3. Body-opening banner + title block

Identical banner (navy `0D2D4F`, Georgia white title, light-blue tagline) and title block styling to Value Stream Profile: `{Stream Name}` (Georgia bold navy 30) / "`{d.pcf}` — `{d.subtitle}` — RACI Assignment" (italic gray 17).

## 4. Stats row — 3 cards, single row (new for this doc type, no direct precedent)

Column widths: 3346/3347/3347 DXA. Same `statCell()` styling as every locked doc type (bordered, `FAFBFD` fill, label gray 13, value bold navy 22).

| Card | Label | Value |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | L3 PROCESSES | `d.l3Count` |
| 2 | L4 ACTIVITIES | `d.activityUnits` |
| 3 | ROLES INVOLVED | `d.roles.length` |

Differs from the domain-wide RACI's 3-card row (Process Groups / L3 Processes Confirmed / L4 Activities Inherited) — a per-stream doc doesn't need a "process groups" count in the same way, and Roles Involved is more useful at this scope.

## 5. Intro paragraph

One paragraph, gray `444444` size 18: "This document reports confirmed R/A/C/I role accountability for the `{Stream Name}` value stream (`{d.pcf}`) — every L4 activity inherits its parent L3's confirmed RACI, since RACI in this framework is assigned at L3 process granularity, grounded directly in real APQC L4 activity text against the Organizational Role Taxonomy."

## 6. Section heading + caption

"RACI Assignment" (bold `0D2D4F`, size 19) + "R = Responsible · A = Accountable · C = Consulted · I = Informed" (gray `888888`, size 14) — no hierarchy-scope caption needed (unlike the domain-wide doc's "Full L1→L2→L3→L4 hierarchy" line), since a stream-scoped doc has no ambiguity about what's included.

## 7. Main table — columns (DXA, sum 10040)

| Column | Width | Align |
|---|---|---|
| PCF | 750 | left |
| L3-Process / L4-Activity | 3200 | left |
| Pattern | 1000 | center |
| R — Responsible | 1450 | left |
| ★ A — Accountable | 1450 | center |
| C — Consulted | 1200 | left |
| I — Informed | 990 | left |

Header row: navy fill, white bold caps, bottom-aligned — identical `headerCell()` to every locked doc type. **L2 banner rows retained** (`EEF3FA` fill, colspan-7, bold navy `0D2D4F` code+name) even for single-L2-group streams — kept for visual consistency with the domain-wide RACI's convention rather than only appearing when structurally necessary. Confirmed working correctly across a genuine multi-group boundary (Enable & Govern, which spans 7.4/7.7/7.8 — three L2 banner rows render in sequence with the RACI table flowing continuously beneath each).

## 8. Row hierarchy, Pattern column, and RACI cell treatment

**Identical to the domain-wide RACI spec, unchanged**: L3 rows get a pattern bar (solid or segmented per §11 of `HITL_Maturity_Docx_Spec.md`), L4 rows get a colored text badge. R falls back to A with a dimmed-italic "from Accountable" note when no separate Responsible exists (`rCellValue()`). A column keeps the neutral `F5F5F5` gray-box fill at every row, never role/pattern colored. Cell-margin indentation for L4 rows (140 base + 260 extra), never paragraph indent. PCF column left-aligned, black text.

## 9. Legend + attribution

Identical compact left-packed 5-item legend to every locked doc type. Attribution line: "★ A = Accountable · RACI grounded in real APQC L4 activity text · `{l3Count}` confirmed L3 assignments in this value stream · © Timothy P. King & Claude (Anthropic) 2026".

## 10. Content-shape decision: the old "Accountable Assignment — Reasoning" section was dropped

The retired `hitl_role_assignment_raci_<stream>_final.docx` doc type carried a per-L3 prose "reasoning" section explaining each Accountable assignment (pageBreakBefore, Courier New PCF code + bold L3 name subheads). That text was never captured as a structured dashboard lens — it only ever existed hand-authored inside the old docx files. Per the standing rule that the dashboard is the authoritative content source (not old docs), and since `Design Narrative` in the companion Value Stream Profile doc already covers substantially the same "why this role holds this Accountability" rationale in prose, **this generator does not reproduce a reasoning section**. Flagged to Tim rather than silently reconstructed from the old files; approved as part of the August 9 lock.

## Build/validation checklist for any new stream

1. Confirm the stream name exact-matches `valueStreams[]` and `lenses.descriptions[]` in the domain JSON — same fail-fast behavior as `gen_stream_profile.js`.
2. Run `node gen_stream_raci.js <domain>.json "<Stream Name>" <slug>`.
3. Convert to PDF and rasterize every page — confirm: banner present, header line 2 doesn't double "PCF", 3-stat row bordered, L2 banner row(s) present and correctly grouping L3s (test against a multi-group stream, not just a single-group one), Pattern bars/badges render per the locked convention, A column keeps neutral gray fill throughout, R falls back to A with the "from Accountable" note where expected.
4. Unzip and grep `word/document.xml` for the Segoe UI docDefault font and `w:caps`/`w:vAlign` on header cells — same raw-XML verification habit as every other locked doc type.

## Known outstanding

- Only verified so far against PCF 7.0 (6 streams, all regenerated and delivered: HR Vision-to-Strategy, Recruit-to-Hire, Perform-to-Grow, Reward-to-Retain, Move-to-Exit, Enable & Govern). PCF 8.0's 8 streams have not yet been run through this generator.
- This closes out the last per-entity doc type still on old styling — every doc type in the framework (Maturity, domain-wide RACI, Value Stream Profile, per-stream RACI) now shares one locked visual language.
